tools.name: list_travel_insurance_plans
tools.description: Lists the travel insurance plans sold by Travel Protection Insurance (www.travelprotection.insure) to US residents: each plan's price as a percentage of trip cost, main coverages and restrictions.

tools.name: get_travel_insurance_coverage_details
tools.description: Returns the covered cancellation reasons, benefit limits and state restrictions for one plan: "standard" or "cfar" (Cancel For Any Reason). Reasons and limits follow the policy form sold in most states; policy_form_note names the states whose form differs.

tools.name: quote_travel_insurance
tools.description: Prices travel insurance for a trip under both plans and says whether Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) coverage is available to this traveler, and why not when it isn't. Nothing is saved or charged.

tools.name: start_travel_insurance_checkout
tools.description: Creates a quote for the traveler and returns a link to finish on www.travelprotection.insure. Requires the traveler's name and email, shared only with the traveler's agreement. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_travel_insurance_coverage_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Reasons and limits follow the policy form sold in most states; policy_form_note names the states whose form differs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
